disposition: Two explicit awaited phases recommended; no final source approval until repair and parent composition reviewed

Trusted node freshness must remain unchanged; no post-warp private call or additional catch-up should be necessary.

Before returning real-wall mining scope, parent completes encrypted journal reopen, public HTTP rebuild, canonical all-transaction/fee/proof checks, records authenticated absence anchor and closes private actor/PXE services.
Parent asserts original mining scope stopped and automining restored. No detached continuation Promise, new miner or overlapping lifecycle.

Phase2 consumes continuation once before official settlement/refund, uses only parent native public node and original depositor L1 client, then canonical receipt/effect and escrow accounting rechecks.

Final absent state is preserved through canonical state continuity: exact earlier absence anchor and exit remain canonical, with equal note-hash/nullifier roots and sizes or authenticated empty intervening effects. Do not fake a closed-PXE zero result.
Mark full passed only after final refund, canonical state and public tombstone continuity checks; retain paid partial outcomes on failure and forbid retry of uncertain external action.
requiredNegativeChecks: Second/fabricated finalization token rejected before callbacks.
